nz001.title: Olympus XA2 D.Zuiko 35mm F3.5 35mm Film Camera with A11 Flash Working
nz001.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
nz001.details: Olympus XA2 compact 35mm film camera with a D.Zuiko 35mm F1:3.5 lens and the A11 electronic flash. The shutter fires and the aperture works, and the flash was confirmed to fire. It has not been test-shot with film, and the shutter speed was not checked. The lens shows slight dust, slight fungus and slight haze, and the viewfinder is quite dirty. The Olympus logo above the flash is missing, and the body shows light signs of age and use. The A11 flash is included. No battery is included; the camera takes two LR44 batteries and the flash takes one AA battery.
nz001.why: The XA2 is a pocket-sized zone-focus 35mm film camera from Olympus with a sharp D.Zuiko 35mm F3.5 lens.
nz001.perfect: Film photographers who want a small, light compact camera and are comfortable with a cosmetically worn, lightly hazy example.
nz001.exp: A working XA2 with the A11 flash, with the dust, fungus, haze and viewfinder dirt described above.
nz001.cd: Pre-owned. Shutter fires, aperture works and flash fires; not test-shot with film. Slight dust, fungus and haze in the lens, and a dirty viewfinder. Olympus logo above the flash is missing. A11 flash included, no battery. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
